description: Read the latest metrics and resource states for a temporary anonymous demo simulation: latency, CPU, throughput, error rate, cost status, and per-resource health. When costComplete=false, costPerHour is omitted from the compact headline and pricedResourceSubtotalPerHour is labeled incomplete. GPU-readiness aggregate P95 is ESTIMATED from a generic reference, not GPU-specific. Use it to inspect current state and metrics history without advancing time; do not use it to move the simulation forward — that is simulation.step. MySQL databases automatically receive an additive metrics.mysqlPreparedStatementForecasts result (top-level mysqlPreparedStatementForecasts in compact and stateless results), without opt-in. Set characteristics.databaseEngineIdentity='mysql' or an authoritative MySQL identity; names do not qualify. Supplemental characteristics.mysqlPreparedStatementForecast supplies server caps, initial prepared/open counts, finite horizon, explicit timeOrigin, provenance and future offered-workload windows with open-connection profiles. Missing required inputs yield unavailable with missingInputs; no universal baseline/cap or pool-budget substitution. Crossings use seconds from the supplied origin, a 15-second grid and half-open windows; gaps advance time without offered volume. rungRps is null without explicit rungs; no_crossing_within_horizon is finite, not never. This forecast never injects errno 1461 or changes metrics/decisions. Conditional rung validation only: 2× m5.large + db.r5.large MySQL 8.0, max_connections 500, cap 24,630, cwm-bench f0e1c228; observed onset was 286–383 seconds earlier than forecast (late forecasts), not a timing pass. Other configurations are extrapolations. Source/parameters are not downloadable. For bounded exports use authenticated REST GET /api/simulations/{simulationId}/metrics?limit=100&includeTelemetry=true and follow nextCursor with limit until null. REST pages without includeTelemetry=true omit JSON telemetry; omit limit/cursor for the unchanged complete heavy history. MCP compact/full behavior is unchanged. Recommended timeline workflow: call simulation.step with steps up to 500 within runtime budgets (and remaining demo quota), then call simulation.metrics once with responseMode:'full'. Full metrics[] contains all persisted checkpoints still retained for this simulation, including intermediate metrics[].kubernetes[].gpuReadiness[] and metrics[].kubernetes[].gpuReadiness[].overCapacityRps when recorded. These are modeled readiness/capacity assumptions, not measured GPU performance. Legacy or non-applicable rows may omit these fields; full mode does not reconstruct missing telemetry. History may be cleared on reset or removed on deletion/expiry; it is not an archival guarantee. Responses are compact by default: principal current metrics plus explicit modeled goodputRps (a post-step point rate sourced from throughput, with provenance), goodputWindow (recorded only from persisted simulation-clock bounds, otherwise unavailable with provenance; never derive it from retrieval time or currentStep), errorBreakdown when available, per-resource status (id, name, status, cpuPercent, routedRps, availabilityState, isRoutable, and recoveryBlockedReason when provided), seeded EKS Spot checkpoint history and migrationEvaluationComplete/provenance when present, and the last 10 metrics-history entries. Pass responseMode: 'full' to get the complete simulation state, normalizedConfig, and full metrics history instead. During recovery, each resource may include recoveryProgress.state (parked, cooling_down, or healthy) with parkWindow and cooldown counters; poll simulation.step until healthy, then use simulation.metrics to inspect the resulting state and metrics. GPU / inference workflow: when the simulation includes a kubernetes resource with characteristics.inferenceMode: true, the response also includes top-level gpuUtilization (%), tokensPerSecond, costPerMillionTokens (USD/M tokens), idleGpuCostPerHour (USD/hr of standby GPU spend), and idleGpuFraction (0-1 idle HA overhead share) from the latest step, with inference fields on history entries when recorded. Pass the simulationId returned by simulation.create when your connector opens a fresh MCP session; preserve Mcp-Session-Id to use the omitted-ID current-simulation default. A fresh session has no current-simulation pointer. At least one simulation.step is needed for meaningful metrics. Read-only; no API key required, only this session's owned demos are accessible. History reads do not execute steps or consume the demo step quota. The likely next tool is simulation.step or simulation.inject_traffic.

responseMode.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default) returns principal current metrics, errorBreakdown when available, per-resource status (id, name, status, cpuPercent, routedRps, availabilityState, isRoutable, recoveryBlockedReason, and failureLifecycle/routingState when provided), and only the last 10 metrics-history entries. 'full' returns the complete simulation object plus all persisted metrics[] still retained, not only the batch's final step. After simulation.step batching, read once with 'full' for intermediate metrics[].kubernetes[].gpuReadiness[] and metrics[].kubernetes[].gpuReadiness[].overCapacityRps when recorded; legacy/non-applicable rows may omit them. responseMode is MCP-only: REST GET /api/simulations/{simulationId}/metrics already returns full persisted history.

simulationId.description: Simulation ID returned by simulation.create. Preserve Mcp-Session-Id to omit this field and use the session's current simulation; if your connector starts a fresh MCP session for each call (for example Grok Bot or Cursor), pass this explicit ID after every fresh initialization. A fresh session has no current-simulation pointer and returns NO_ACTIVE_SIMULATION when the ID is omitted. Anonymous capabilities are short-lived (30 minutes by default), unguessable, and revoked when the demo expires or is deleted; proxy IP changes do not invalidate them. Do not treat the ID as a durable share link.

name: simulation.metrics

outputSchema.description: Compact metrics summary by default (principal current metrics, per-resource status, bounded history tail). With responseMode 'full', the complete simulation object and full metrics history are passed through instead.

auroraFailovers.description: Latest compact per-writer database failover state, with failed and standby IDs and phase.

promotedResourceId.description: Promoted database resource ID; standbyResourceId is retained as a compatibility alias.

benchmarkCalibration.description: Latest per-step calibration provenance: MEASURED outputs at observed points, MODELED projection outside them, ASSUMED configuration, and the CWM model assumptions used.

calibrationId.description: Versioned owned calibration identifier; present only when that calibration applies.

kind.description: owned for the exact AWS CRUD fit; owned-scaled when derived from that fit outside its exact fleet size; modeled when the gate fails or another generic model applies.

latencyBasis.description: General modeled latency path, such as in-VPC ALB rather than end-to-end; see latencyP99Basis for percentile-specific P99 provenance.

latencyP99Basis.description: Percentile-specific P99 basis: owned in-VPC internal-ALB fit, scaled from that fit (not directly measured), or uncalibrated generic model.

note.description: Names the fit scope and limitations. For canonical workload inference, states it is a modeling assumption. For modeled fallback, names all actual failed checks in stable order with resource IDs and safe expected/actual values; never only a generic 'not applied'.

identity.description: Canonical Cloud SQL billing identity belongs only in characteristics.cloudSql. Example: {"characteristics":{"cloudSql":{"engine":"mysql","tier":"db-custom-2-7680","region":"us-central1","edition":"ENTERPRISE","availability":"ZONAL","diskType":"PD_SSD","allocatedGiB":100}}}. Misplaced edition, availability, diskType, allocatedGiB, databaseVersion, tier and HA/disk-specific inputs are rejected with field-specific errors. Shared characteristics.engine, size/instanceType, capacityGB and resource.location are supported aliases; conflicting nested/alias values are rejected. Missing fields remain explicit inputGaps; complete configurations without verified meters remain pricing evidence gaps, not missing inputs.

costComplete.description: Whether the estimated cost includes all resources.

costPerHour.description: Latest complete estimated cost in USD/hr; omitted from compact output when costComplete=false.

costPerMillionTokens.description: Latest self-hosted inference cost in USD per million tokens (null when no tokens are being processed) — present only on GPU inference simulations

costStatus.description: Whether the cost headline is complete. Incomplete output uses pricedResourceSubtotalPerHour instead of costPerHour.

declaredFleetConnectionBudgetBasis.const: ASSUMPTION / maximum declared fleet × app pool size; not observed live DB connections

loadDerivedBasis.const: load-derived estimate; not observed live DB connections

effectiveConfigHash.description: Versioned prediction hash over replay startup inputs, engine version, and calibration identity.

eksSpotInterruptions.description: Latest seeded EKS interruption telemetry, including additive migrationEvaluation/provenance when recorded.

checkpointEvidence.description: Persisted seeded-EKS checkpoint captured with its interruption JSONB record. engineInputStepIndex is an engine input-step index, simulationSeconds is derived from that index and the recorded tick, and traffic provenance points to outer metric fields rather than duplicating float values.

migrationEvaluation.description: Authoritative additive seeded EKS interruption evaluation. Field values carry recorded/derived/unavailable provenance; deadline verdict/counts/reasons are frozen once status is completed and do not describe later service health.

engineVersion.description: Simulation engine version used for this prediction.

errorBreakdown.description: Validated additive error contributors from the latest metrics entry, in percentage-point units; distinguishes database connection pressure below the usable limit from pool saturation after exhaustion

databasePressureDetails.description: Per-database causes contributing to pressure below the usable connection limit.

cause.description: Modeled source of this database's under-limit pressure contribution.

resourceId.description: Database resource ID contributing to modeled under-limit connection pressure.

poolSaturationDetails.description: Per-database pool exhaustion details, including the cause when available. Modeled demand is not observed live sessions.

cause.description: Why this database's modeled connection demand exceeded its usable pool limit.

demandBasis.const: modeled connection demand; not observed live sessions

modeledConnections.description: Modeled demand/assumption, not observed live sessions.

resourceId.description: Database resource ID whose modeled demand exceeds its usable limit.

usableConnectionLimit.description: This database's effective usable connection limit.

staleDNS.description: Modeled failed-request contribution in percentage points from stale DNS routing to unavailable regional compute; not an additional independent error rate.

errorRate.description: Latest client-level error rate (%) against original offered RPS. Resilience dependency targets in autoscaled compute fleets use aggregate routable-fleet capacity and health; non-autoscaled targets use their resolved resource capacity, including any declared fixed-instance count.

excludedCostDetails.description: Named resources excluded from the partial cost when costComplete=false.

externalMetrics.description: Latest deterministic external-metric recommendation telemetry, including each trigger's sample status/outcome/value/desired capacity and the combined capacity decision. It never actuates simulated or provider resources.

goodputProvenance.description: Provenance for the modeled goodput field

goodputRps.description: Modeled client-level successful requests per second; a post-step point rate sourced from metrics.throughput. Resilience dependency targets in autoscaled compute fleets use aggregate routable-fleet capacity and health; non-autoscaled targets use their resolved resource capacity, including any declared fixed-instance count.

goodputSemantics.description: Goodput is a point rate, not an interval total

goodputWindow.description: Interval goodput aggregate when every point has persisted simulation-clock bounds; otherwise status=unavailable. Never derive this from retrieval time or currentStep.

gpuUtilization.description: Latest GPU utilization (%) — present only on GPU inference simulations

idleGpuCostPerHour.description: Latest USD/hr of GPU spend funding idle/standby capacity (HA overhead) — present only on GPU inference simulations

idleGpuFraction.description: Latest share (0-1) of the GPU bill that is idle/standby capacity — present only on GPU inference simulations

kubernetesCpuHpa.description: Latest per-workload bounded CPU HPA telemetry, including input provenance and missing-request errors; no Kubernetes controller parity is claimed.

modelScope.const: workload-replicas-only; no Kubernetes controller parity claim

latencyBasis.description: Latest general modeled latency path/boundary; see latencyP99Basis for P99-specific provenance.

latencyP50.description: Latest 50th-percentile latency in ms; null when workload-specific latency evidence is unavailable.

latencyP95.description: Latest 95th-percentile latency in ms; null when workload-specific latency evidence is unavailable.

latencyP99.description: Latest modeled 99th-percentile latency in ms; null when workload-specific latency evidence is unavailable. Interpret with latencyP99Basis and predictionEvidence.latencyP99.

latencyP99Basis.description: Latest percentile-specific P99 basis: owned fit, scaled-from-fit (not directly measured), or uncalibrated generic model.

metricId.description: Storage-assigned ID of the latest persisted metric

metrics.description: Metrics history — bounded to the last 10 entries in compact mode, full history in full mode

costPerHour.description: Complete estimated cost in USD/hr; omitted from compact rows when costComplete=false.

costPerMillionTokens.description: Self-hosted inference cost in USD per million tokens for this step — present only on GPU inference simulations

errorBreakdown.description: Validated additive error contributors for this history entry

errorRate.description: Client-level error rate (%) against original offered RPS. Resilience dependency targets in autoscaled compute fleets use aggregate routable-fleet capacity and health; standalone targets count once.

gpuUtilization.description: GPU utilization (%) for this step — present only on GPU inference simulations

latencyBasis.description: General modeled latency path/boundary; see latencyP99Basis for P99-specific provenance.

latencyP50.description: Median latency in ms; null when workload-specific latency evidence is unavailable.

latencyP95.description: 95th-percentile latency in ms; null when workload-specific latency evidence is unavailable.

latencyP99.description: Modeled 99th-percentile latency in ms; null when workload-specific latency evidence is unavailable.

latencyP99Basis.description: Percentile-specific P99 basis for this history record.

metricId.description: Storage-assigned persisted metric ID, when this history entry was stored

resilience.description: Per-step resilience telemetry, including external-metric trigger outcomes when configured.

retryAmplificationFactor.description: Per-step (original offered RPS + generated retry RPS) / original offered RPS — present only when resilience is enabled; an amplification measure, not capacity or goodput.

tokensPerSecond.description: Inference throughput in tokens/second for this step — present only on GPU inference simulations

metricsHistoryLength.description: Total number of metrics-history entries (compact mode returns only the last 10)

modeledShedRps.description: Latest aggregate modeled shed requests per second

offeredRps.description: Latest aggregate offered requests per second

predictionEffectiveConfigHash.description: Versioned prediction hash over replay startup inputs, engine version, and calibration identity.

pricedResourceSubtotalPerHour.description: Priced-resource subtotal in USD/hr when costStatus is incomplete; not the full cluster cost.

effectiveConfigHash.description: Original replay-only SHA-256 of the effective six-control startup configuration; top-level effectiveConfigHash is the versioned prediction identity.

scenarioHash.description: Canonical SHA-256 of the persisted scenario graph and attached traffic-pattern order

residualCostDefinition.description: Definition of residual cost; total cost remains the complete billed total.

residualCostPerHour.description: Subtotal of unavailable, parked, or stopped resource costs; healthy/degraded idle resources, including ALBs, are excluded.

resilienceDiagnostics.description: Bounded resilience diagnostics from the latest step (compact mode). Absent when the resilience model did not run.

bounded.description: True when a generated-traffic, traversal-work, or cascade-depth bound truncated model work

capacityByResource.description: Unique logical dependency resources in the latest step; each appears once even when several paths reference it. When values are finite, nominalCapacityRps minus warmupCapacityLossRps (members still warming) and healthCapacityLossRps (unavailable or degraded members) equals routableCapacityRps, within rounding.

healthCapacityLossRps.description: Aggregate capacity lost because members are unavailable or degraded; zero means no modeled member-health loss

nominalCapacityRps.description: Aggregate capacity before warm-up and member-health reductions; null means no finite capacity ceiling is known

resourceId.description: Logical resource ID used by one or more resilience dependency paths

role.description: Whether this resource is a dependency source, target, or both

routableCapacityRps.description: Aggregate capacity available to this logical resource after modeled warm-up and member health; null means no finite capacity ceiling is known

warmupCapacityLossRps.description: Aggregate capacity lost because fleet members are still warming up; zero means no modeled warm-up loss

incidentOutcome.description: Latest incident outcome: stable | degraded | cascading | protected | recovered

pathCount.description: Number of dependency paths evaluated in the latest step

modelScope.const: generic-pod-lifecycle; modeled estimates, not controller or proxy parity

availabilityState.description: Availability derived from lifecycle and routed traffic: available = serving normally, degraded = critical/warning but still serving, unavailable = failed/parked, scaled_to_zero and cold_start = Fargate no-task states

failureLifecycle.description: Read-only failure lifecycle marker when the backend identifies a quick injection or typed instance failure

isRoutable.description: Whether this compute/Kubernetes resource can receive traffic in this step; false distinguishes a failed/parked node from a critical node still serving

recoveryBlockedReason.description: Engine recovery guard currently preventing cooldown progress, when present (for example failure_park_window or idle_cpu_floor)

recoveryProgress.description: Read-only recovery progress; poll simulation.step until state is healthy, then use simulation.metrics to inspect the result

routedRps.description: Requests per second routed to this resource (compute/kubernetes only)

routingState.description: Read-only current routing state for a resource with failure lifecycle telemetry

retryAmplificationFactor.description: Latest (original offered RPS + generated retry RPS) / original offered RPS; an amplification measure, not capacity or goodput. Values > 1.0 = amplification risk. null = model ran but no traffic. Absent = resilience model disabled.

simulation.description: Complete simulation state (full mode only; absent in compact mode and when status is not_found/access_denied)

resources.description: Resource states with health and status

tokensPerSecond.description: Latest inference throughput in tokens/second — present only on GPU inference simulations

datasetGiB.description: Total resident-memory plateau in GiB, INCLUDING initialGiB; not additional allocation or on-disk dataset bytes. Must be >= initialGiB. Other services and host reserve are separate. Example: initialGiB=1, datasetGiB=4 grows from 1 to 4 GiB, not 5 GiB; a 100 GiB input file does not imply 100 GiB resident memory.

initialGiB.description: Starting total resident working-set memory in GiB for this batch container, not dataset file size.
